answer: Miscellaneous >> Islamic Names Question ID: 150792 Country: india Title: About Name Question: I have kept my son name as Shah Ibrahim Affan, is it ok and correct to have this name? As someone told me that it is not right to have two names “Ibrahim” & “Affan”. Please advice he is already 4 years now. Answer ID: 150792 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 817/774/B=8/1438) This name is correct. Whosoever told that it is not good to keep both the names i.e. Ibrahim Affan he is not right. This name is correct. There is no need to change it. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
